caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model across six epochs, comparing two fine-tuning strategies: "tiny full" and "base full." The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6, while the y-axis shows the WER, which decreases from approximately 28.8 to 22.8. The "tiny full" fine-tuning strategy, represented by a grey dotted line with triangle markers, starts at a WER of 28.8 and shows a steady decline, reaching a WER of 22.8 by epoch 6. In contrast, the "base full" fine-tuning strategy, shown as a blue dotted line with triangle markers, begins at a WER of 21.9 and also decreases, ending at a WER of 18.8 by epoch 6. Both strategies demonstrate a consistent reduction in WER over the epochs, with the "base full" strategy consistently achieving a lower WER than the "tiny full" strategy throughout the training process.
